name: Hilde Vautmans - Considérant AO - Am 40/2
title: REPORT on a European Parliament recommendation to the Council, the Commission and the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy concerning EU-China political relations
part_text: AO. whereas the EU’s most recent China strategy dates from 2019; whereas a unified, pragmatic, consistent, comprehensive and principled EU policy towards China is therefore needed to determine the EU’s future in global affairs; whereas the EU-China comprehensive strategic partnership should be based on the current geopolitical situation and therefore have a clear focus on the EU’s values, strategic autonomy, interests and priorities, including security;
